build_kimiaudio_tokenizer: build a KimiAudioTokenizer from a local vocab file or HuggingFace repository ID
create_tiktoken_encoding: create a TikToken encoding from a vocab file with base64-encoded token ranks and special tokens
encode_text_tokens: encode a text string into a list of token IDs using the Kimi-Audio tokenizer
decode_tokens_text: decode a list of token IDs back into a text string with optional special token skipping
apply_chat_template: apply a Jinja chat template to a list of conversation messages and optionally tokenize the result
